transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, nice to meet you too. Well, what made me come in is that... after work or class, I’ll sit down with my laptop and just end up eating a really large amount of food. 

Like, I'll finish a whole takeout meal, plus chips, sweets, and whatever snacks I have stashed in my desk drawer. It's way more than I ever plan to eat when I sit down, and definitely a lot more than I’d ever eat around anyone else. I just wanted to talk to someone about it.
After these episodes, do you do anything to try to make up for what you ate?

No, I don't. Um, I don't throw up or take anything, if that's what you mean. And I don't really exercise to burn it off either. I mostly just... sit there feeling really overly full and kind of mad at myself. But I don't do anything to actually try and undo it.
How often do these episodes happen?

Um, I actually looked back through my journal and my food delivery charges recently to check. They've been happening most weeks ever since the restructuring started at my job. It's usually more than once a week, so... yeah, it's definitely not just a here and there kind of thing.
Have these episodes been happening at least once a week for three months or more?

Yeah, definitely. Like I mentioned, when I checked my journal and my delivery apps, I realized it's been going on for a while now. The restructuring at work happened about four months ago, and it's been happening most weeks since then. So yes, definitely longer than three months, and usually a couple of times a week.
